about: TravaCalm Original is the only anticholinergic product supplied and its one brand-only line identifies both dimenhydrinate and hyoscine hydrobromide.
Overlapping supplies of oxybutynin (Ditropan) and promethazine (Phenergan) appear in the middle of the history for a 70-year-old patient.
Ditropan and Endep were supplied 22 days apart, but the Endep directions record that oxybutynin stopped on 9 August before amitriptyline began on 11 August.
